summary.intent: Design and document a 'Keywords' feature for MemoryRecord that allows user-provided keywords to boost injection scoring, then write a formal design doc.
summary.outcome: The design for Keywords on MemoryRecord was verbally approved by the user; the assistant began writing the design doc but the transcript ends before completion. One file (cmd/entire/cli/summarytui/root_test.go) was modified.

repo: MemoryRecord injection scoring uses a buildRecordMatchSignals/scoreRecord pattern with weighted token overlap
Keywords are intended to get a 3x multiplier (score weight 21 vs 7) over regular title+body tokens in scoreRecord()
Keywords do not bypass status/confidence/strength gates — records still compete normally
Manual memory creation goes through AddManualRecord; keywords would be set there and via a new Edit flow
Generated memories have empty keywords by default; users can add them via Edit
TUI memory management lives in cmd/entire/cli/memorylooptui/ (wizard.go, tab_settings.go, messages.go)
